build_dinov3_linear_classifier: build a DINOv3 ViT-7B/16 linear classifier for ImageNet-1k classification using dinov3_vit7b16_lc
create_linear_classification_head: create a pretrained linear classification head with 1000 output classes using _make_dinov3_linear_classification_head
create_linear_classifier_wrapper: create a LinearClassifierWrapper that concatenates cls and mean patch tokens before the linear head
run_dinov3_classification: run inference with a DINOv3 linear classifier on images using dinov3_vit7b16_lc pretrained on ImageNet-1k
review_classifier_weights_enum: review the ClassifierWeights enum to understand available pretrained weight options for linear classifiers
